title: Severe hematopoietic stem cell inflammation compromises chronic granulomatous disease gene therapy.
authors: Sobrino, Steicy; Magnani, Alessandra; Semeraro, Michaela; Martignetti, Loredana; Cortal, Akira; Denis, Adeline; Couzin, Chloe; Picard, Capucine; Bustamante, Jacinta; Magrin, Elisa; Joseph, Laure; Roudaut, Cecile; Gabrion, Aurelie; Soheili, Tayebeh; Cordier, Corinne; Lortholary, Olivier; Lefrere, Francois; Rieux-Laucat, Frederic; Casanova, Jean-Laurent; Bodard, Sylvain; Boddaert, Nathalie; Thrasher, Adrian J; Touzot, Fabien; Taque, Sophie; Suarez, Felipe; Marcais, Ambroise; Guilloux, Agathe; Lagresle-Peyrou, Chantal; Galy, Anne; Rausell, Antonio; Blanche, Stephane; Cavazzana, Marina; Six, Emmanuelle
one_liner_zh: 该文研究慢性肉芽肿病基因治疗中造血干细胞炎症状态，虽用回归模型预测植入失败，但核心是细胞状态与临床结局，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: X-linked chronic granulomatous disease (CGD) is associated with defective phagocytosis, life-threatening infections, and inflammatory complications. We performed a clinical trial of lentivirus-based gene therapy in four patients (NCT02757911). Two patients show stable engraftment and clinical benefits, whereas the other two have progressively lost gene-corrected cells. Single-cell transcriptomic analysis reveals a significantly lower frequency of hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs) in CGD patients, especially in the two patients with defective engraftment. These two present a profound change in HSC status, a high interferon score, and elevated myeloid progenitor frequency. We use elastic-net logistic regression to identify a set of 51 interferon genes and transcription factors that predict the failure of HSC engraftment. In one patient, an aberrant HSC state with elevated CEBPbeta expression drives HSC exhaustion, as demonstrated by low repopulation in a xenotransplantation model. Targeted treatments to protect HSCs, coupled to targeted gene expression screening, might improve clinical outcomes in CGD.
abstract_zh: X连锁慢性肉芽肿病（CGD）与吞噬功能缺陷、危及生命的感染及炎症并发症相关。我们对四名患者进行了一项基于慢病毒载体的基因治疗临床试验（NCT02757911）。其中两名患者表现出稳定的植入和临床获益，而另外两名患者则逐渐失去基因校正细胞。单细胞转录组分析显示，CGD患者中造血干细胞（HSCs）的频率显著降低，尤其是在植入失败的两名患者中。这两名患者表现出HSC状态的深刻变化、高干扰素评分以及髓系祖细胞频率升高。我们使用弹性网络逻辑回归识别出一组包含51个干扰素基因和转录因子的特征，这些特征可预测HSC植入失败。在一名患者中，异常的HSC状态伴随CEBPbeta表达升高，驱动HSC耗竭，这通过异种移植模型中的低再增殖能力得到证实。针对保护HSC的靶向治疗，结合靶向基因表达筛查，可能改善CGD的临床结局。
